source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: When an enemy unit that is neither a MONSTER nor a VEHICLE Falls Back while in Engagement Range of any of your units that have this ability, each of its models has to make a Desperate Escape test, and if the enemy unit is Battle-shocked too, 1 is subtracted from every one of those tests.

trigger.enemyWithinEngagementRangeOf: one or more friendly units with this ability

effect.desperateEscapeTests: every model in the enemy unit
